description: This file contains unit tests for the User class in the OpenMRS project, verifying role management and superuser status functionalities.

classes.name: UserTest
classes.description: Test suite for the User class, covering role assignments, superuser checks, and case-insensitive role containment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a User object with a role before each test.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldHaveRole
methods.description: Tests that the user correctly reports having a role that was added.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldNotHaveRole
methods.description: Tests that the user correctly reports not having a role that was not added.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldHaveAnyRoleWhenSuperUser
methods.description: Verifies that a superuser has any role regardless of specific roles assigned.

methods.name: hasRole_shouldNotHaveAnyRoleWhenSuperWhenIgnoreSuperUserFlagIsTrue
methods.description: Checks that the flag can prevent superusers from having implicit roles.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldBeSuperUser
methods.description: Verifies that the user is recognized as a superuser after adding the superuser role.

methods.name: isSuperUser_shouldNotBeSuperUser
methods.description: Ensures that a user without the superuser role is not recognized as such.

methods.name: containsRole_shouldBeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Tests that role containment checks are case-insensitive.

methods.name: containsRole_shouldReturnTrueIfTheUserHasTheGivenRole
methods.description: Verifies that containment check returns true for existing roles.

methods.name: containsRole_shouldReturnFalseIfTheUserDoesNotHaveTheGivenRole
methods.description: Verifies that containment check returns false for non-existing roles.
